release_notes: The S2S status filter no longer breaks on update: it now also matches the network's own status word and honors pre-1.5.11 'custom' chips, so campaign postbacks configured before the status aliases keep delivering without touching anything. Conversions missed during the break can be re-queued with one button (campaign editor -> S2S Postbacks -> Re-send missed, last 72 hours). The postback tester explains compatibility matches and flags template placeholders (bbg=xxx, [YOUR_...]) that would ship to the source as literal values; source S2S seeding never offers a template URL with unfilled slots. Panel translations interpolate their variables again - the tester verdicts and the source hint render as real text instead of {from}/{name}. Note: the {status} macro in a postback URL always carries the internal status (sale), not the network's word.
